Missy is a moderately active, quiet girl who is having a hard time feeling comfortable in the shelter environment. She can be fearful and defensive when approached, and will need a patient, experienced adopter who understands that building trust takes time.

Missy has a reported history of bite and scratch incidents involving a person and another cat, so she will need a specialized placement through a New Hope partner. An adult-only home is recommended, with no other cats unless the adopter has significant experience with careful cat introductions.

With a calm environment, patience, and understanding, Missy deserves the chance to feel safe and build confidence at her own pace. â¤ï¸

Due to the detailed behavior issues, this animal is only available for foster/adoption through one of ACC's New Hope Partners. If you are interested in adopting or fostering, please fill out the pre-screener form. This animal is not directly available for adoption through ACC and is only available by completing the pre-screener form.Adoption inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.
